name: Marine & General Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，公告主要为股东大会、季度业绩、附加上市及财务资助等事项。最新一季（截至2026年7月31日）营收同比下降19.3%，净利润同比下降62.1%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company made no announcements involving expansion, new business, reduction or divestment of business segments; announcements mainly covered general meetings, quarterly results, additional listing and financial assistance. In the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue fell 19.3% year-on-year and net profit fell 62.1% year-on-year.
